children: Stock-specific action remained in focus on Dalal Street on September 16, with investors reacting to corporate developments and brokerages view.
Shares of Saatvik Green Energy rose 5% after company received an order worth Rs 1,041.63 crore from Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI) for the supply of solar PV modules.

Sonata Software share price down 2% despite its arm Sonata Information Technology signed a five-year Strategic Collaboration Agreement (SCA) with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to accelerate cloud adoption and modernisation for enterprises across India.

Share price of India Pesticides rose 5% after company has obtained Technical Equivalence approval for one of its insecticide products in the United Kingdom. Further, it has also successfully obtained registration for one of its herbicide products in Argentina.

VIP Industries share price added 2% as board meeting is scheduled to be held on September 18 to consider a proposal to raise funds, in one or more tranches, through the issuance of equity shares, debt securities and convertible securities.

Shares of Aurobindo Pharma shed nearly 2% after United States Food and Drug Administration (US FDA) inspected Unit-II, an API manufacturing facility of the company’s subsidiary Apitoria Pharma in Telangana, from September 7 to 15, 2026 and issued one observation, which is procedural in nature.
Among sectors, the IT index fell 1%, while pharma declined 0.5%. FMCG, Media, PSU Bank and Realty indices gained more than 1% each.
The broader market remained under pressure, with the Nifty Midcap 100 index trading in negative territory, while the Nifty Smallcap 100 index slipped 0.6%.
Market breadth on the BSE remained weak, with 1,496 shares advancing against 2,222 declining and 168 remaining unchanged.

title: Price Action: Saatvik Green Energy rises 5% on Rs 1,041cr order win; Aurobindo Pharma down 2% on USFDA observation
